visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: One Rule for Every Position
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The first character gets special handling, and the loop then checks the previous character with magic number 32. Write a capitalize function with one rule that covers every position. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A character starts a word when it is first or follows a space. One condition covers both cases, toupper leaves non-letters alone, and the logic is packaged in a reusable function.
